question_text: What is the main obstacle in the way of removing illiteracy? Why?
guide_solution: Ignorance is the main obstacle in the way of removing illiteracy. Because it hinders the process of concerted efforts to remove illiteracy from society.

subject: English
question_text: The pie chart below shows the passing rate of different
stimulus: subjects in class ten in the Half yearly exam of 2014 in Savar Cantonment High School, Dhaka. Write a paragraph on the pie chart. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the passing rate of different subjects in class ten in the half yearly exam of 2015 in Bogra Govt. Girls' High School, Bogra. It represents the passing rate of the four subjects. It points out that highest number of students passed in Bangla and it was 77%. The second highest was in English and 55% students passed in that subject. Only 42% students passed in Science and it was the third highest in terms of passing rate. The lowest number of student passed in Mathematics and it was only 38%. The pie chart makes it clear that the students of class ten of Bogra Govt. Girls' High School were very much week in Mathematics and Science. Almost half of them failed in English. So, they were also weak in English. In Bangla, they were much stronger then other subjects although there was scope for improvement..
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 119 — Pirojpur Govt. High School
